pages.text: An abundance of $(item)Osmium Ore$() can be found between world height level 24-60

pages.title: Deep Substrate Ore
pages.text: $(item)Deep Substrate Ore$() can be fond between world height level 0-24.$(br2)We recommend using fortune or silk touch when acquiring this ore.$(br2)Silk touch is probably the most handy option since it can be directly pulverized into the $(item)Fine Kalthrite Coating$().
